registers.name: GICR_INVALLR
registers.description: Redistributor Invalidate All Register。GIC Redistributor (GICR) 寄存器

fields.name: V
fields.description: [当 GICv4.1 is implemented] 指示是否 the INTID is virtual or physical. [0b0=针对物理 INTID 的使无效操作。 ; 0b1=针对虚拟 INTID 的使无效操作。]；否则为 RES0

fields.name: vPEID
fields.description: [当 GICv4.1 is implemented] 当 GICR_INVLPIR.V == 0, this 字段 is RES0 当 GICR_INVLPIR.V == 1, this 字段 is the target vPEID of the invalidate. 此字段大小是 IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED，由 GICD_TYPER2.VIL and GICD_TYPER2.VID 字段s. Unimplemented bits are RES0.；否则为 RES0
